summary: MoneyHero Limited filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a voluntary current report) disclosing the departure of Chief Commercial Officer Shravan Thakur effective December 22, 2026, tied to a new country-manager-led structure across Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan and the Philippines. No replacement CCO will be named; commercial and marketing functions consolidate under each country manager. Interim CEO and CFO Danny Leung continues, and the Board is still searching for a permanent CEO. Chairman Steven Teichman thanked Thakur and said strategic priorities are unchanged. Watch for permanent CEO appointment and any further senior departures.
